projecthero.guide.omnitrix.alien.swampfi: A Methanosian: a walking swamp plant who sweats methane and sets it alight. Fire and lava cannot hurt him and he regrows a heart every two seconds (faster while he burns). Fireballs and a torch of burning gas, seed bombs, vines that snare and swing him about, a methane cloud he can ignite, roots bursting from the ground -- and an ultimate firestorm round him. Cold is his weakness.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.swampfire.role: Plant pyrokinetic: fire, methane and vines -- and he keeps growing back.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.swampfire.pass: Methanosian Body: immune to fire and lava.
Regrowth: heals 1 health a second, 2 while burning or standing in fire.
Burning Fist: his punches set the target alight.
projecthero.omnitrix.info.swampfire.weak: Cold: freezing damage (powder snow, ice attacks) hurts him twice as much.
Ignite needs a methane cloud of his to light first.
projecthero.omnitrix.swampfire.fire_blas: A methane fireball from your palm: 7 damage and alight for 4 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.swampfire.methane_t: A cone of burning gas from both hands, 8 blocks: 14 damage and alight for 5 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.swampfire.seed_bomb: Lob a seed pod that bursts on impact: up to 15 damage in 3.5 blocks, roots them for 1 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.swampfire.vine_snar: Vines burst from the ground round the creature you look at (20 blocks): 6 damage, rooted for 3 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.swampfire.methane_j: A jet of burning gas launches you up and forward; no fall damage for 1.5 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.swampfire.vine_swin: Shoot a vine at the block you look at (22 blocks) and haul yourself to it.
projecthero.omnitrix.swampfire.methane_c: Let out a 4-block cloud of methane for 6 s: 2 damage a second and nausea to everyone in it.
projecthero.omnitrix.swampfire.ignite.de: Set your methane cloud off: a 5-block fireball, 18 damage and alight for 5 s.
Root yourself for 3 s and regrow: +2 health every half second (12), poison and wither cleared. Not at full health.
projecthero.omnitrix.swampfire.bloom.des: Make the plants and crops within 4 blocks grow, like bone meal.
projecthero.omnitrix.swampfire.root_erup: A line of root spikes bursts up ahead of you, 10 blocks: 16 damage and launched.
projecthero.omnitrix.swampfire.inferno_b: ULTIMATE: a 1 s build-up, then a methane firestorm round you -- 55 damage at the centre, 40 at the 8-block edge, alight for 8 s.
projecthero.omnitrix.swampfire.burning_f: Your punch sets the target alight for 3 s.
message.projecthero.omnitrix.swampfire.n: No block for the vine to catch.
No methane to ignite -- let out a cloud first (Z).
